# Universe background textures

## Earth

- `earth-day.jpg`: https://threejs.org/examples/textures/planets/earth_atmos_2048.jpg
- `earth-night.png`: https://threejs.org/examples/textures/planets/earth_lights_2048.png

Downloaded unchanged, 2026-09-18. Official Three.js examples repository. MIT notice is preserved in `THREE-ASSETS-LICENSE.txt`. NASA provenance for these specific Earth files was not independently established.

## Milky Way

- `milky-way.jpg`: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004800/a004851/milkyway_2020_4k_print.jpg
- Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4851/
- Credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
- Usage: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

The original 1024×512 small JPEG preview is unchanged; the renderer applies a blue tint. These are decorative background maps, not live geographic data. Connection arcs are a visual metaphor and do not describe AIWin locations or customer deployments.

Composition and atmosphere reference the user's two supplied AI Universe 2026 posters. Poster copy, dates, and registration graphics are not part of the background texture.
